paired_requirement_wording: Both hidden variants use one identical declarative wrapper and manually paired declarative bodies frozen in paired-requirements.json. Variant-specific instructional prefixes are forbidden and validated before sealing.
variant_assignment: For each of 30 cases and five paired replicate indices, (case_index + replicate_index) parity assigns one hidden requirement variant identically across all three conditions. Fifteen even and fifteen odd case indices yield 75 source-faithful and 75 injected-drift target-replicate pairs, or 225 runs per variant.
workspace_base_note: Public origin/main immediately before the source-frozen delayed-feedback audit and target-drift case artifacts were added.
primary_endpoint: expert-adjudicated exact contract satisfaction under hidden balanced source-faithful versus injected-drift requirements
primary_analysis_unit: fixed set of 30 equally weighted targets; each target's five design-matched ABRL-minus-source-aware invocation differences are partitioned into source-faithful and injected-drift cells of frozen sizes 3/2 or 2/3, and each cell is resampled at its original size
primary_success_rule: lower endpoint of the fixed-target, variant-preserving paired-invocation bootstrap interval above zero; report faithful-request specificity and injected-drift sensitivity alongside the primary result
secondary_endpoints: false_rejection_rate (descriptive exact complement of specificity; excluded from BH)
recovery_cost_definition: Number of adapter trace tool_call events marked recovery_phase=true after the first observable failed Lean build; raw build attempts, wall time, tokens, and monetary cost are reported separately. Proof-route failures without an observable failed Lean build are outside this estimand.
build_observation_grammar: An observable Lean build is a direct lake build or lake env lean invocation at command start or after &&, ||, ;, or a newline. Mentions such as echo lake build are not build attempts. More than one direct build in one command event is ambiguous_build_accounting and makes the run infrastructure_failure.
wording_negative_control: Before primary execution, freeze and report the deterministic leave-one-pair-out text-only diagnostic, one independent blind wording review, and one frozen-model source-absent label audit. These controls quantify residual prior-knowledge or wording predictability; they are not formalization outcomes and cannot be pooled with the 450 runs.
dependence_plan: Use a fixed-30-target, variant-preserving paired-invocation bootstrap as the primary interval: do not resample targets; within every target-by-requirement-variant cell, resample aligned ABRL-minus-source-aware replicate differences with replacement at the original cell size, preserving each target's frozen 3/2 or 2/3 variant allocation and equal target weight. Pairing means the same target, replicate, requirement variant, and randomized condition block, not shared provider randomness. Interpret the interval only for new independent invocations under the frozen benchmark, model, runtime, and protocol. Report each source paper and the textbook stratum separately; retain the exact sign-flip over three paper-source clusters plus twelve textbook targets and leave-one-paper-out estimates as sensitivity analyses; do not generalize to a target or paper population.
pilot_policy: Exactly one case by three conditions by one replicate may be used for an end-to-end infrastructure smoke test. The independent hash-bound smoke plan and runner must assign execution_purpose=real_infrastructure_smoke, primary_result_eligible=false, and checked_smoke_nonexperimental even after a successful production checker. Smoke outputs are permanently excluded from the 450-run result set, blind grading, and inferential analysis.
replacement_policy: Never replace a challenge or requirement variant after observing workflow difficulty or failure.
missing_run_policy: Freeze complete_450_no_replacement_no_imputation_v1 before execution. Continue the remaining preregistered schedule after an individual failure; never replace a run and never impute an outcome. A sealed completion ledger must cover all 450 semantic run IDs. Blind grading and inferential analysis require 450/450 production-result-eligible records; otherwise emit only a cause/condition/variant missingness report with no effect estimate, interval, p-value, or success claim.
blinding_boundary: Evaluated agents receive opaque run IDs and one proposed requirement. The checker sandbox receives only a pristine condition-view snapshot, submitted patch, public declaration names, expected file hashes, and opaque/hash bindings; it never receives the sealed pack, operator metadata, source bank, challenge ground truth, semantic IDs, condition label, or requirement variant. Primary graders receive normalized final artifacts and neutral post-hoc checker evidence, not condition labels, prompt paths, presentation order, contract/blueprint provenance, internal gate names, condition-specific workflow manipulation checks, or execution cost, duration, token, tool-call, build-attempt, and retry metadata. Workflow compliance and execution metrics remain in the digest-bound operator-only mapping and are restored only when the adjudicated analysis record is assembled.
workflow_manipulation_check: Every run emits a hash-bound workflow-compliance record. Compile-only has no condition-specific evidence file; source-aware must hash a run-local blueprint; ABRL must hash a target contract, blueprint, failure ledger, and promotion-gate log. Neither the condition-specific artifacts nor their common pass/fail manipulation check is shown to primary graders; the pass/fail value is retained in the operator-only mapping and restored for secondary analysis after adjudication.
